<p class="has-text-align-left has-text-color has-background wp-block-paragraph" style="color:#0c309c;background-color:#ffffff00;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-top:0;padding-right:0;padding-bottom:0;padding-left:0;font-size:clamp(0.935rem, 0.935rem + ((1vw - 0.2rem) * 0.864), 1.41rem);font-style:normal;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3"></p>

<section class="wp-block-group alignfull has-text-color has-background has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-a915bc64 wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained" style="color:#252525;background-color:#ebf9fb;margin-top:0px;padding-top:3.51rem;padding-right:1rem;padding-bottom:5.5rem;padding-left:1rem;font-size:clamp(0.875rem, 0.875rem + ((1vw - 0.2rem) * 0.464), 1.13rem);font-style:normal;font-weight:400;line-height:1.4">
<div class="wp-block-group has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-d2a766d4 wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-46a46ac7 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex" style="margin-bottom:3.01rem;padding-left:1rem">
<div class="wp-block-column has-global-padding is-content-justification-left is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-column-is-layout-69d0b17a wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained">
<div class="wp-block-group has-global-padding is-content-justification-left is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-79bc8aa9 wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-left has-text-color" style="color:#12a3e3;margin-top:2.01rem;margin-bottom:0rem;font-size:clamp(1.556rem, 1.556rem + ((1vw - 0.2rem) * 1.916), 2.61rem);font-style:normal;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3">Join us in the Far North of NZ to kitesurf and wingsurf </h1>
</div>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-column has-global-padding is-content-justification-left is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-column-is-layout-877e0d0e wp-block-column-is-layout-constrained" style="flex-basis:60%">
<div class="wp-block-group has-global-padding is-content-justification-left is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-ae12e0f6 wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained" style="padding-top:2.8rem;padding-right:0%">
<p class="has-text-align-left has-text-color wp-block-paragraph" style="color:#0c309c;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0rem;font-size:clamp(0.875rem, 0.875rem + ((1vw - 0.2rem) * 0.064), 0.91rem);font-style:normal;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5">We have travelled the world kiteboarding, and the best location we ever found to kitesurf is the Karikari Peninsula at the top of New Zealand. So we set up a kitesurf school there and now spend each UK winter there. Flat water locations for learning and freestyle, and waves for playing &#8211; it&#8217;s kitesurfing and wingfoiling paradise!</p>
<p class="has-text-align-left has-text-color wp-block-paragraph" style="color:#0c309c;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0rem;font-size:clamp(0.875rem, 0.875rem + ((1vw - 0.2rem) * 0.064), 0.91rem);font-style:normal;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5"><br>The variety of conditions, locations and equipment we have in New Zealand, combined with the amount of windy days, gives the opportunity to gain a range of experiences in a period of weeks or months that might take years to achieve elsewhere.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-color" style="color:#393939;font-size:clamp(1.044rem, 1.044rem + ((1vw - 0.2rem) * 1.029), 1.61rem);font-style:normal;font-weight:500">Kite camps </h2>
<p class="has-text-color wp-block-paragraph" style="color:#252525;margin-top:1.01rem;font-size:clamp(0.875rem, 0.875rem + ((1vw - 0.2rem) * 0.045), 0.9rem);font-style:normal;font-weight:500">Stay from a week to a month or more. Begin your kitesurfing journey with daily kitesurfing lessons, or develop your skills from first transitions, to first tricks and jumping with ongoing coaching. </p>
<div class="wp-block-group is-vertical is-content-justification-stretch is-layout-flex wp-container-core-group-is-layout-c1d5a89d wp-block-group-is-layout-flex" style="margin-top:1.51rem;padding-right:0px;padding-left:0px">

<div class="wp-block-group alignwide has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-f3feecca wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained" style="padding-top:0rem;padding-right:0;padding-left:0">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="Kite-camps"><strong>Kitesurf and wing foil camps</strong></h1>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Immerse yourself in kitesurfing and&nbsp;beach life. At kite camp we can take you forward from whatever level you have reached &#8211; whether you are an absolute beginner, already a kitesurfer wanting to improve your skills, try new disciplines, or nail a new trick. Or if you just want to get out there and play.</p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-large-font-size"><strong>Kite and wing foil camps with training&nbsp;</strong></h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">For beginner students, we will be in the water with you right by your side for your first sessions, and then as you become more independent and are up and riding, we will be there giving tips and supervising you from the beach, and in the water with hands on teaching as and when you need it.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Camps include a three day kitesurfing or wing surf and wing foil course or supervised equipment hire, and a week&#8217;s shared accommodation. When you are not kitesurfing or winging, you can be busy surfing, SUPing, snorkelling, working out in our woodland gym or just chilling out on the beach. As well as other Kite Camp student/kiters, we may also have instructor students staying on site, giving you the opportunity to learn in great depth about equipment, weather, tides, and all things important to becoming a good all round kitesurfer. There is always a great mix of people and you can choose to keep yourselves to yourselves, or join in camp life.</p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-large-font-size"><strong>Kite/Wing Camp prices</strong></h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Camp prices are based on shared self catering accommodation, and include all training and equipment hire and activities as above:<br><br>One week &#8211; $1495<br>Two weeks &#8211; $2985<br>Three weeks &#8211; $4200<br>Four weeks &#8211;  $5861<br><br>A supplement of $50 per night applies for stays between 20th December and 12th January, and during holiday weekends including Labour Day, Auckland Anniversary Day and Waitangi Day. Single supplement $500 per week (if available).</p>

<h1 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Become an IKO kitesurf instructor</strong></h1>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If your dream includes becoming a kitesurf instructor and travelling the world doing this amazing sport and living an amazing life, you can come to kite camp on one of our <a href="https://www.kitesurfnz.com/become-an-iko-instructor/fast-track-kitesurf-instructor-course/" data-type="page" data-id="599">fast track&nbsp;beginner to IKO instructor level courses</a>.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This can take you from absolute beginner to IKO kitesurf instructor in 12 weeks, or just improve your level enough to join an IKO kitesurf instructor course from your current riding standard.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We know it can be hard to get time out on the water when you live in Europe, and other parts of the world. So come to the Karikari Peninsula, and get out there!!</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Take a look at posts on our Facebook page between Nov and April each year for a taste of life at kite camp. The other months we are in the UK or Europe. We need to get better at posting pictures, we are just out there having too much fun to be posting! We will upload more soon. </p>
</div>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
